description: This file defines syntax highlighting and mode configuration for Dart language in CodeMirror, a JavaScript-based code editor component.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Creates an object with given words as keys for quick lookup.

methods.name: pushInterpolationStack
methods.description: Pushes current tokenization state onto the interpolation stack.

methods.name: popInterpolationStack
methods.description: Pops and returns the last tokenization state from the interpolation stack.

methods.name: sizeInterpolationStack
methods.description: Returns the size of the interpolation stack.

methods.name: tokenString
methods.description: Handles string tokenization, including triple-quoted strings and interpolation.
